author: IGN
description:
Check out the final Arco trailer for this animated film about a 10-year-old boy from a peaceful, distant future who accidentally travels back to the year 2075 and discovers a world in peril. As Arco develops a charming and touching friendship with a young girl named Iris, they band together and along with her trusted robot caretaker Mikki, set out on a quest to get Arco home, while the two children may also be the only ones who can save our planet.

Arco is an enchanting fable from breakout filmmaker Ugo Bienvenu, produced by Remembers’ Bienvenu and Felix de Givry, and mountainA’s Natalie Portman and Sophie Mas.

Arco is now playing in theaters.
title: Arco - Official Final Trailer (2026)

author: IGN
description: Get a closer look at Unsealed: The Mare in this latest trailer for the upcoming first-person psychological horror game where you play as Vera, trapped in a nightmare tied to her family’s tragic past. In Unsealed: The Mare, find and destroy cursed objects and restore lost memories to unlock sealed doors, reveal hidden areas, and survive challenging, terrifying encounters. Unsealed: The Mare will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC on March 10, 2026.
title: Unsealed: The Mare - Official Release Date Trailer | Perp Games Horror Showcase 2026

author: IGN
description: Take a look at the It Reaches announcement trailer for the upcoming first-person survival horror game, captured through the lens of a police officer's body cam. Trapped inside the facilities of an abandoned hospital, find a way to escape the horrors lurking underground. Solve puzzles, manage resources, hide in the shadows and use everything you can to fight back. Just don’t get caught. It Reaches will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in 2026.
title: It Reaches - Official Announcement Trailer | Perp Games Horror Showcase 2026

author: IGN
description: Watch the latest Painted in Blood trailer for the FPS game to see what some critics are saying about Chapter 1. Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements. Painted in Blood is out now in Steam Early Access, with Chapter 1 of 3 available now and Chapter 2 currently in development. A full release of Painted in Blood launches on Steam in 2027.
title: Painted in Blood: Chapter 1 - Official Accolades Trailer | Perp Games Horror Showcase 2026

author: IGN
description:
Get a fresh look at The Relic: First Guardian in this latest trailer for the upcoming dark fantasy action RPG. The new trailer for The Relic: First Guardian gives a peek at gameplay and dives into the tale of a terrifying foe, as the trailer notes this is "A cruel reimagining of the Korean folk tale: The Heavenly Maiden and the Woodcutter." In The Relic: First Guardian, find fragments of the broken great relic in a vast semi-open world and close the void. Embark on an adventure through Arsiltus as a guardian, piece together stories, and complete epic boss fights and dungeons in a bid to restore the world.

The Relic: First Guardian will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox, and Steam on May 26, 2026.

#IGN #gaming
title: The Relic: First Guardian - Official Trailer | Perp Games Horror Showcase 2026

author: IGN
description: Check out the Bleak Faith: Forsaken teaser trailer for this upcoming DLC for the Soulslike open-world survival horror action RPG. In Bleak Faith, explore the last remnants of civilization in this vast, unforgiving, and interconnected world. Learn what is left of its history. Discover pockets of natural life in the perpetually expanding Omnistructure. Lose yourself in a journey unlike any other. Find your purpose in the world. Bleak Faith is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. The Bleak Faith: Forsaken DLC will be out in 2026.
title: Bleak Faith: Forsaken - Official DLC Teaser Trailer | Perp Games Horror Showcase 2026

author: IGN
description: Watch the Greyhill Incident: Reprobed Edition trailer for the story-driven survival-horror game. Greyhill Incident is about a classic Alien-Invasion which takes place during the early 90s. As Ryan Baker, equipped with a baseball bat and a few bullets in his revolver, the story takes you across the atmospheric neighborhood of Greyhill which is invaded by UFOs & Grey Aliens. Greyhill Incident: Reprobed Edition features an all-new ending, plus collectible tapes featuring new lore from the town residents. Greyhill Incident: Reprobed Edition will be available on Nintendo Switch on February 10, 2026.
title: Greyhill Incident: Reprobed Edition - Official Release Date Trailer | Perp Games Horror Showcase 202

author: IGN
description:
Here's your look at the AMIGO: The Broken Loop announcement trailer for the upcoming first-person narrative-driven psychological thriller that follows Julien after the death of her friend. As she investigates the mysterious "Focus on Dream" corporation, Julien uncovers a distorted world of memories, puzzles, and secrets – where nothing is quite what it seems. AMIGO: The Broken Loop will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in 2027.

#IGN #gaming
title: AMIGO: The Broken Loop - Official Announcement Trailer | Perp Games Horror Showcase 2026

description: Borderlands 4 finally added the oft-requested photo mode in their newest update, but that's just the top of the iceberg when it comes the crazy amount of changes. Between visual overhauls, loot changes, boss fixes, and more, there's been a ton added or tweaked under the hood. Let's go over the biggest changes in the photo mode update.
title: Borderlands 4 - Biggest Changes In Photo Mode Update

From jokes about CM Punk's reaction at Summerslam 2025, to Tiktoks about the Wargames moment with Roman Reigns, we show CM Punk the best (and worst!) CM Punk Memes in the world.

author: IGN
description:
Watch the Season 8 Trailer for Outlander, a romantic drama distributed by Starz. Take a look at new scenes from the upcoming season as the series comes to a close. Outlander Season 8 premieres on March 6 on Starz.

As Season Eight begins, Jamie and Claire soon find the war has followed them home to Fraser’s Ridge, now a thriving settlement that has grown and flourished in their absence. With new arrivals and changes made during their years away, the Frasers are confronted with the question of what they are willing to sacrifice for the place they call home and, more importantly, what they would sacrifice to stay together. While the Frasers keep a united front against outside intruders, family secrets finally coming to light threaten to tear them apart from the inside. Although they’ve left the war for America’s freedom behind, their fight for Fraser’s Ridge has only just begun.
 
Outlander Season 8 premieres on March 6 on Starz.
title: Outlander Season 8 - Official Trailer (2026)

author: IGN
description: Check out the Launch Trailer for The 9th Charnel, a first-person psychological survival horror game developed by Saikat Deb. Players will embody Michael J. Jones in demented circumstances that leave him stranded in an empty valley, living through a nightmare. Navigate the dangers that lie ahead, fight for survival, and uncover the truth in The 9th Charnel, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: The 9th Charnel - Official Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Front Mission 3: Remake, a new installment in the classic turn-based tactical strategy RPG series developed by MegaPixel Studio. Players will fight on the frontlines of dangerous military sectors as tensions reach a fever pitch. Lead a team of Wanzers in intense turn-based battles as the fate of the region hangs in the balance. Front Mission 3: Remake is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam and GoG).
title: Front Mission 3: Remake - Official Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description:
After about four hours with Aniimo, I’d say I’m still cautiously optimistic. It has all the ingredients of my favorite games: open-world exploration set in a fantastical alien world, lots of critters to collect, challenges to complete, and… farming? Okay, there might be a few too many ingredients added to this pot, but I’m willing to let Aniimo cook. Previewed by Shailyn Cotten

#IGN #Gaming
title: Aniimo Preview: All the Fun of Creature-Catching With All the Transactions of Gacha

description:
Join the developers of High On Life 2 for a behind-the-scenes look at the creation of High On Life 2 in this latest video for the upcoming comedy FPS sequel. In this new video, the developers discuss the challenges of comedy writing for this follow-up to the 2022 game, including composing funny lines for guns and more. High on Life 2 will be available on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox PC, Xbox Cloud, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) on February 13, 2026.

An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity in High On Life 2! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through the exotic locales to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

#IGN #Gaming

author: IGN
description:
Go Ninja Go! Check out the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2: The Secret of the Ooze 35th Anniversary trailer for the upcoming 35th anniversary theatrical re-release of the film. Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2: The Secret of The Ooze 35th Anniversary opens in theatres nationwide for a week from March 13 - 19, 2026, and tickets are now on sale. 

Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2: The Secret of the Ooze will be presented in theatres in a newly restored 4K presentation. In addition to the feature presentation, the anniversary event will include a never-before-seen featurette, The Ninja Turtles: Revolutions, appearing before the movie—step into the mind of TMNT co-creator Kevin Eastman, joining him on a vision through the past. Sit down alongside the icon at his personal drawing desk while he illustrates through the revolving history and mythos of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles legend.

#IGN #TurtlemaniaReturns #TMNTII35
title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2: The Secret of the Ooze 35th Anniversary - Official Trailer (2026)

description:
Enjoy your first proper look at gameplay from Devil of the Plague, a co-op-enabled horror game with survival elements that the developers call "ritual horror." You play a plague doctor in an ancient cult known for sorcery and disease. The challenge grows as you progress through each city, boss fight, and ritual. 
Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested ahead of its Early Access release in April, and look for a playable demo during Steam Next Fest in February: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429890/Devil_of_the_Plague/

description:
Check out the latest trailer for Mewgenics from Edmund McMillen and Tyler Glaiel! 

Mewgenics is a brand new upcoming strategy roguelike game where you build your own cat army! Take on challenging turn-based battles as you selectively and tactically breed and genetically manipulate your very own cat army! 

Mewgenics launches on PC (Steam) February 10th 2026!
title: Mewgenics - Official Features Trailer

author: IGN
description:
The cheeky retro ‘80’s tone appeals to my thirst for nonsense, the run-and-gun sidescrolling action channels the likes of Contra or Metal Slug, and the roguelike system of upgrades and repeated failure against daunting odds made it extremely hard to put down. I went from this not being on my radar at all, to eagerly anticipating when it comes to Steam Early Access later this year, making this an early contender for my most anticipated indie game of 2026. Previewed by Travis Northup

#IGN #Gaming
title: Huntdown: Overtime Preview: A Goofy, Retro, and Delightfully Violent Roguelike

author: IGN
description:
Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! This week Daemon, Max, and Ryan look at the possible ups and downs of a delay of the PlayStation 6. With PS5 software sales holding strong, and with prices for gaming components like RAM skyrocketing, there's a real possibility Sony will wait another few years before debuting the PS6. This could make the current generation the longest console cycle so far, with 8 or more years from the launch of the PS5 and the possibile drop of the PS6. Plus we have last week's poll results, and a new poll for you to vote on at IGN.com.

#IGN #Gaming
title: The Pros & Cons of Holding Back the PS6 - Next-Gen Console Watch

author: IGN
description:
GeniGods: Nezha is a premium, pay-upfront, hardcore action role-playing game set against the chaotic backdrop of ancient Chinese genesis mythology. You are the Spirit Pearl—the very first spark of life forged by Nüwa, the Goddess of Life, from the essence of earth, water, and fire. In this epic journey, you will evolve from a celestial artifact into the first human, a woman crafted from water and clay, before eventually being reborn as the legendary Nezha. Your journey is shared by legendary heroes: Yi, the sun-feller, and Yu, the flood-tamer. Beside you also dwells the Heart of Sacred Water—Nüwa’s sentient gift that grows with you, serving as your vital companion to solve ancient puzzles, conquer the toughest trials, and learn the dark truth behind this new world.
GeniGods: Nezha will be available on PlayStation 5 and PC.
title: GeniGods: Nezha - Official Reveal Trailer

author: IGN
description:
When No Rest for the Wicked first entered Steam Early Access in April 2024, it was clear Moon Studios was aiming for something ambitious—but that launch version was only the beginning. Over the next two years, the game would be repeatedly transformed through major updates, sweeping system reworks, massive world expansions, and even a shift from a purely single-player experience to full co-op. This video breaks down how No Rest for the Wicked evolved from its rough Early Access debut into the far more expansive and refined action RPG it is today.
